column3: BSB follows the critical text with “Jesus” alone; the Textus Receptus reads “Christ Jesus.” “Set your focus on” renders “consider.”
BSB supplies “Jesus” and “the builder of a house.”
BSB follows the critical text without “firm to the end,” which the Textus Receptus adds; “is faithful” and “God’s” are supplied.
BSB moves “for forty years” from the start of verse 10 into this verse.
BSB has “for forty years” in verse 9; “Their hearts are always going astray” renders “they always go astray in heart.”
BSB renders “in falling away” as “that turns away.”
BSB renders “through Moses” as “Moses led out.”
